name: Apple FastFrames (S 1.3B / L 14B) — interactive-latency video diffusion
summary: Apple ML Research released FastFrames-S (1.3B) and FastFrames-L (14B), autoregressive two-step video diffusion models built on Wan2.1. They generate 480p video at interactive latency: about 35 ms per step on 1 GPU for S, per the README profiling. The release also includes a LingBot 1.3B world-model variant said to be 16x faster, with fluid camera control, plus code for the demo, T2V, VBench and training.

access.license: Apple Machine Learning Research Model License (apple-amlr)
access.notes: Weights are limited to non-commercial research and so are any derivatives. Code is under Apple's sample-code license (GitHub LICENSE). Needs Linux x86-64, an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA 12.8. L targets multi-GPU setups.

procedure: Download the FastFrames weights from Hugging Face (apple/FastFrames-S or -L) and the third-party weights, following docs/installation.md#checkpoints
Run scripts/generate.py --model ff-s, or the LingBot demo at localhost:8000

verdict.why: Primary Apple release of open weights with code and an arXiv paper, a concrete latency claim, and a world-model angle for interactive scenes. Research-only, so it can't ship in products.
